title: Dell Technologies and Armada sign strategic MoU to accelerate mobile and edge data infrastructure across Saudi Arabia
summary: The MoU was signed during LEAP 2026 in Riyadh
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
contentHtml:
Mohamed Talaat, Vice President, Saudi, Egypt, North Africa & Levant (SENAL), Dell Technologies and Rabee El Mohammadi, Vice President, Sales and Partnerships, MEA at Armada. Image Courtesy: Dell Technologies

The MoU was signed during LEAP 2026 in Riyadh

Press Release

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia – Dell Technologies and Armada have announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to join forces in delivering containerized Mobile and Edge Data Center solutions across Saudi Arabia.

The MoU was signed during LEAP 2026 in Riyadh between Mohamed Talaat, Vice President, Saudi, Egypt, North Africa & Levant (SENAL), Dell Technologies and Rabee El Mohammadi, Vice President, Sales and Partnerships, MEA at Armada. The MoU establishes a strategic framework to address high-demand projects that require fast, flexible access to localized compute and storage capabilities.

Under the MoU, Dell’s enterprise hardware and modern infrastructure stack, is envisaged to be integrated with Armada’s specialized mobile, containerized data center solutions, enabling high-performance infrastructure for customers across the Kingdom.

The joint initiative will focus on key sectors including energy, telecommunications, manufacturing and public infrastructure by expanding reach to enterprise customers through Dell’s authorized regional channel partner network. By bringing compute and storage closer to where data is generated, the collaboration is intended to support real-time Edge AI applications, strengthen data sovereignty and help maintain operational continuity in remote and resource constrained environments.

Mohamed Talaat, Vice President, Saudi, Egypt, North Africa & Levant (SENAL), Dell Technologies, said:

“Our collaboration with Armada represents a pivotal step in expanding resilient, mobile edge infrastructure across Saudi Arabia. By pairing Dell’s high-performance hardware stack with Armada’s containerized data center design, we are empowering enterprises to deploy Edge AI with speed, scale and reliability in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.”

Rabee El Mohammadi, Vice President, Sales and Partnerships, MEA at Armada, said:

“This strategic MoU with Dell Technologies significantly strengthens Armada’s ability to deliver mission-critical AI and edge infrastructure across Saudi Arabia. Combining our edge platform with Dell’s world-class technology allows us to solve our customers' most demanding operational challenges. Together, we seek to deliver actionable compute directly to field operations, remote assets and critical enterprise environments in the Kingdom.”
